decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service lies outside the firm's maritime core and its announced direction, so dropping it would write off little and expose no public commitment. However, it reuses the firm's existing crewing and recruitment infrastructure and was launched only a year ago, so weak early results can still be blamed on a slow start, which favours a cautious keep.

Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's core crewing network and fits its stated path toward integrated maritime solutions. That makes it a visible commitment, and any disappointing results would likely be read as temporary ramp-up effects, so the firm would persist with it.
